basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old video editor based in Hattiesburg, Mississippi. I have a passion for all things related to film and video production, and I spend a lot of my free time exploring new editing techniques and tools. I work freelance, which allows me flexible hours, but I usually find myself online in the evenings. I'm currently in a long-term relationship, and we're navigating the complexities of balancing careers and personal life. I love discussing tech and film editing, but I also enjoy winding down with some light-hearted entertainment. However, I dislike unnecessary drama and negativity online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Film and Media Studies and have been working in the video editing industry for over 10 years. Most of my knowledge comes from hands-on experience and continuous learning through online forums, tutorials, and the Final Cut Pro subreddit. I love sharing tips and tricks with fellow editors.
